title: A New Home
content: I have a few homes in Mall World that I go to frequently, but this morning I visited a new one. It was in a building, there was a long hallway with a few business and more apartment doors. It had three stories, with each one having a shorter ceiling than the one below. The top floor had an exit that led to a room just full of random stairways connecting to other apartments and a shared basement which was dark and the light on my phone wouldn't turn on. Anyone else have an apartment like that? Been down to the basement?
